items.description: Clean affected floors in utility room and hallway
items.rationale: The washing-machine leak qualifies as escape of water under 2.4.2, and 7.1.7(h) covers necessary cleaning of both affected floors. The combined estimate is €100 for the utility room plus €110 for the hallway, gross.
Section 7.1.7(e) covers checking the source and confirming that it no longer leaks, even if the appliance itself is not insured. The estimate is €147 gross for one inspection.

items.description: Remove and dispose of damaged skirting
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1 cover removal and disposal of the damaged fixed trim. The comparable lump-sum job supports €76 gross for the whole line.
Fixed skirting is insured under 4.2.2, and 7.1.5 and 7.1.9 limit replacement to affected trim of equivalent quality. The closest lump-sum reference supports €134 gross.

items.description: Measure floor moisture in both affected rooms
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(b) covers moisture measurement needed to assess and dry the affected floors. One survey of both rooms is estimated at €126 gross.
Section 7.1.7(b) covers necessary drying in the affected rooms. The comparable flat-rate drying charge is €239 gross, with any duplicate cost excluded under 7.1.8(c).
Section 7.1.7(e) covers necessary equipment hire if it is not already included in the drying charge under 7.1.8(c). The separate rental is estimated at €71 gross.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary trade labour at customary rates, provided it does not duplicate the drying charge under 7.1.8(c). Four hours at €76 gross per hour total €304.
Section 5.2.6 expressly covers specialist transport of affected artwork despite the contents exclusion in 4.3(d). One local transfer is estimated at €45 gross; no agreed shared limit is evidenced.

Section 5.2.6 expressly covers qualified examination, and the claim confirms that a professional restorer assessed the painting. One assessment is estimated at €70 gross; no agreed shared limit is evidenced.

Section 5.2.6 expressly covers necessary drying and stabilisation of affected artwork. The distinct conservation treatment is estimated at €110 gross, provided it is not already included in restoration.

Section 5.2.6 covers restoration following specialist assessment, notwithstanding 4.3(d). Comparable restoration supports €1,262 gross; no scheduled agreed value is shown that would require this line to share a cap with the other conservation measures.
